## Requirements
Satisfy + stamp: **R-2.1.4** (§3.3 C0/Stage-1 per §3.3.13).

Landed surface (this ticket):
- The assembly grammar in the `HIR/1` schema (§3.3.2): `Assembly{dialect, profile_binding,
  slots, parameters, values, entities, constraints, layers?, ext}`, `SlotBinding{variant:
  ComponentVariantRef{class_id, variant_id, version_selector|version_id}, params, enabled,
  locality?}`, `ParameterSpec` (the closed type sum), `Constraint{kind ∈ {requires, conflicts,
  implies, range, authority_cap}, subject, source}`, `LayerProvenance`, `profile_binding ∈
  {unbound, ProfileRef, ProfileConstraint}`; per-field merge policy declared in the schema.
- `ClassRecord`/`VariantRecord` shapes — the S1.8 `hh-registry` records reused (CC1/CC7);
  the class catalog for `control_strategy` and `context_policy` (`ClassCatalog::stage1()`
  from the S1.8 suites module; `from_registry(view)` from a snapshot).
- `load(bytes, expected_dialect?)` → `Assembly | ParseError | UnknownDialect`; unknown
  non-`ext` keys are errors; `load(encode(a)) = a`.
- `validate_assembly(assembly | sealed, class_catalog, profiles?)` → `ValidationReport{status,
  diagnostics[AssemblyDiagnostic], derived{opacity_ratio?, identity_stability, hosting_edges,
  benchmark_conditioned_rules[]}, stages}` — stages 1–5 and 7 run and reported (never
  fail-fast); 6a/6b `n/a{not_run}` (C1/Stage 3/5); hosted root → 2, 6, 7-opacity `n/a{class}`;
  7-L2 `BenchmarkConditionedRule` (error, never warning).
- `resolve(definition, registry_view, environment, mode)` → sealed definition: pins every
  `ComponentVariantRef` (registry snapshot-confined) and entity `Ref` (via `seal`); substitutes
  every `$param`/`$entity`; secrets stay channel names; records `registry_snapshot_id`,
  `resolved_at`; closed / secret-free / idempotent; `execute` refuses revoked heads.
- `identity(sealed)` → root `{semantic_id, version_id}` + the `configuration_id` composition
  through `hh-identity` (CC1).
- `instantiate(sealed, runtime, profile, accounting)` → `HarnessInstance | BindFailure{slot,
  variant, reason}`; every class receives `(profile, accounting)`; `lifecycle.component.bound`
  per binding through the run's single fenced writer.
- `diff(sealed_a, sealed_b)` → `HirDiff` (not a separate object).
- `verify_resume(persisted, current, ledger_view)` → `Compatible | Incompatible{reasons}` with
  the four Core rules; accepted changes → `lifecycle.definition.changed{diff_ref}`.
- The diagnostic taxonomy: `AssemblyDiagnostic{code, class, severity, path, source_layer?,
  subject, stage, detail: Text{owner=kernel}, remedy, owner_adr}` over the closed `C-*` code
  list (ADR-0148 / WS-J1 §6.3 + ADR-0143's L2 code); `C-INT-1` reserved, never emitted.
- The MUST-code / MUST-data lists and the migration ladder rungs published as data.
- `hh-hir` additive extension (CC8): `SlotBinding{variant, params, enabled, locality?}`,
  `ComponentVariantRef{class_id, variant_id, version}`, `ProfileRef::unbound()`, `seal`
  accepts a *resolved* assembly section, granular assembly diff ops, `Rebind` on variant refs.

Spec-staged later (NOT this ticket): `compose` with layers + `authority_cap` enforcement
(Stage 3), `space`/`enumerate` + override grammar (Stage 3), opacity ratio in the bundle
(Stage 3), stage 6a (C1/Stage 3), 6b (C1/Stage 5), the out-of-process variant host and
placement binding (Stage 2), organisation layers (C2), the assembly/registry services (§6).

## Acceptance criteria (gating, deterministic — §3.3.11)
- **AC-CC-01 (T-12)** Stage-1 half: every `ClassRecord.contract` is operations/inputs/
  outputs/invariants/failure modes (structural + C-CLASS-4). Stage-2 half (stub variant
  bound out-of-process per Core class) → DF-S1.9-1.
- **AC-CC-02 (T-08)** `required_inputs ⊇ {ModelProfile, ResourceAccount}` on every catalog
  class (C-CLASS-5); a model-conditioned variant binds with no Core change (the stub runtime
  binds a variant whose `capability_declaration` names the condition).
- **AC-CC-03** `resolve` closed + secret-free; `identity(resolve(a))` stable across two stores
  replayed from one log under one snapshot; two authoring paths → one `semantic_id`.
- **AC-CC-04** every diagnostic carries a path and (when layered) `source_layer`; the
  reference definition validates with zero errors (opacity ratio → Stage 3, `n/a{not_run}`).
- **AC-CC-06 (T-10)** rename → only `SurfaceEdit`, same `semantic_id`; `enabled=false`
  ablation → exactly one `ReplaceField`.
- **AC-CC-07 (T-13)** `verify_resume` refuses removal of a delivered tool, accepts additions.
- **AC-CC-09** ladder + criteria published (spec §3.3.3 + `boundary` module data); ADR-0240
  states its rung; the cross-ADR rung audit → DF-S1.9-4 (CAP.1).
- **AC-CC-10 (CF-056)** the sealed definition carries no selector; `link_precheck` refuses an
  unpinned selector with `C-LINK-1 LinkError{unbound_slot}`; the compiler's `link` (S1.10)
  consumes it → DF-S1.9-3.
- **AC-CC-11** (Stage 3) — one fixture per *landed* code executed early.
- **AC-CC-12 (T-15)** hosted root → stages 2, 6, 7-opacity `n/a{class}`.
- **AC-CC-13** `suite_id`/`task_id`/`foreign_id`/split/family predicate anywhere → error at
  `validate_assembly` and at `resolve` (pre-`seal`); reference definition yields `[]`.
- Universal phase-gate: verification green; fail-if-removed tests; ids stamped; deferrals
  recorded; ADRs for deviations/owned decisions; index + ledger.

## Plan
New persistent crate `crates/hh-assembly` (deps hh-wire/hh-identity/hh-provenance/
hh-ontology/hh-hir/hh-ledger/hh-registry):
1. `grammar.rs` — the typed `Assembly` + closed sums.
2. `schema.rs` — canonical encode/decode (`load`/`encode`), JSON-pointer paths, the
   per-field `MergePolicy` table.
3. `diagnostics.rs` — `AssemblyDiagnostic`, `DiagnosticCode` (closed), `Severity`, `Stage`,
   `Remedy`, `StageOutcome`, `ValidationReport`.
4. `catalog.rs` — `ClassCatalog` (Stage-1 built-in + from a registry snapshot);
   `RegistryView`.
5. `validate.rs` — stages 1–5, 7 (+ 6 `n/a`), hosted `n/a{class}`, L2 check.
6. `resolve.rs` — resolve → seal; `Environment`; idempotence; `link_precheck`.
7. `identity.rs` — root ids + configuration-id composition.
8. `instantiate.rs` — `Runtime` trait, `StubRuntime`, `HarnessInstance`, `BindFailure`.
9. `resume.rs` — `verify_resume`, `LedgerView`.
10. `events.rs` — `lifecycle.component.bound` / `lifecycle.definition.changed` + `emit`.
11. `boundary.rs` — MUST-code / MUST-data / ladder rungs.
12. `hh-hir` additive changes (records/refs/schema/ops/diff) + tests.
13. Tests: unit per module + `tests/{grammar,validate,resolve,diff,instantiate,resume}.rs`
    + the per-code fixture battery.
14. ADR-0240; DEFERRALS DF-S1.9-1..4; closeout docs.

## Test matrix (landed names — `tests/acceptance.rs` 26 + `src` unit 3)
- Grammar/codec: `load_encode_round_trip_over_a_full_assembly`,
  `load_rejects_unknown_keys_and_bad_dialect` (C-LOAD-1/2/3),
  `merge_policy_is_declared_for_every_grammar_field_and_longest_prefix_wins` (unit),
  `load_rejects_malformed_and_wrong_dialect` (unit).
- Validation: `a_clean_assembly_passes_all_stages_with_6a6b_not_run` (AC-CC-04's
  n/a rows), `validation_is_never_fail_fast` (planted multi-error → every
  diagnostic), `stage2_missing_mandatory_slot_is_class_cardinality` (C-CLASS-3),
  `hosted_root_reports_na_class_for_class_stages` (AC-CC-12/T-15),
  `parameter_space_diagnostics` (C-PARAM-1…5 incl. `ParamUnused` = warning,
  `DefaultedBudgetRelevant` = warning), `constraint_violation_is_cons_1`
  (C-CONS-1), `benchmark_conditioned_references_are_errors_never_warnings`
  (AC-CC-13 — `C-LCD-4`, error severity), `every_diagnostic_carries_a_path_and_
  a_typed_code` (per-code fixture battery — AC-CC-11's landed-code half).
- Resolve: `resolve_pins_selectors_records_the_snapshot_and_seals` (AC-CC-03 —
  `resolved{registry_snapshot_id, resolved_at}`, all slots `version_id`-pinned),
  `resolve_is_idempotent` (`resolve(resolve(d)) = resolve(d)` byte-identical —
  ADR-0240 §3), `resolve_substitutes_params_entities_and_keeps_secret_channel_names`
  (closed + secret-free), `resolve_execute_mode_refuses_a_revoked_head`
  (C-REF-4 `StaleIndex`, ADR-0037), `resolve_rejects_benchmark_conditioned_rules`
  (AC-CC-13 at resolve/pre-seal).
- Identity: `identity_exposes_root_and_configuration_ids` (§3.3.6 —
  seedless `configuration_id` stable, seeded `configuration_version_id` varies).
- Diff (AC-CC-06/T-10): `diff_classifies_a_variant_rebind_as_rebind` (`Rebind`),
  `a_disabled_binding_is_exactly_one_replace_field` (`enabled=false` →
  `ReplaceField`); rename → only `SurfaceEdit`, unchanged `semantic_id` is
  covered at the HIR layer (`hh-hir/tests/corpus.rs` AC-IR-05 second half).
- Instantiate (T-LCD-08): `instantiate_binds_in_process_variants_and_stamps_
  component_bound` (`lifecycle.component.bound` per binding through the
  caller's fenced writer), `instantiate_reports_a_typed_bind_failure`
  (`BindFailure{reason: trust_denied}` → `C-TRUST-1`-classed event),
  `a_model_conditioned_variant_binds_without_touching_core` (AC-CC-02 second
  half — a `model_family`-conditioned variant registers/resolves/binds on the
  data-only path).
- Resume (AC-CC-07/T-13): `verify_resume_refuses_removal_of_a_delivered_tool`
  (`context.artefact.delivered` witness), `verify_resume_allows_additions`
  (`Compatible{diff_ref: sha256:…}`), `verify_resume_refuses_a_dialect_change`
  (rule `dialect_changed`).
- Link/boundary: `link_precheck_refuses_an_unresolved_selector` (AC-CC-10 —
  `C-LINK-1`), `the_must_lists_and_rung_are_declared` (AC-CC-09 — both lists
  non-empty/disjoint, `RUNG = C0`).
